36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
41949: A mysterious young boy with a huge djinn within his flute. His name is based on 'Aladdin and the Magic Lamp'. He travels in search of metal vessels that contain other djinns. He has a pure and innocent, yet wise personality that dislikes fighting.
42501: Initially, after an incident, he fled his home country of Balbadd, and resided in Qishan where he worked as a cart driver. He dreams of getting rich enough to buy a country. Alibaba was a teenager when Aladdin randomly met him on his journey.
42502: (first appearance), 23 (now) Judar is one of the four Magi in the current era and a Magician who specializes in Ice Magic. He is the former Oracle of Al-Thamen and the Kou Empire after siding with Hakuryuu to aid him in taking over Kou Empire.
42528: He is the king of Sindria and the leader of the Alliance of the Seven Seas. He was 14 years old when he first captured a dungeon, the first dungeon "Bael". Since then, he had sailed the seven seas and captured seven dungeons.
42529: One of the eight generals, he uses the weapon household's vessel "Balalark Sei." His loyalty towards Sinbad is so high that he'll approach anyone who insults him with murderous intent. When Sinbad does things as he pleases, Ja'far worries endlessly and sometimes even feels faint.
43121: Descendant of the hunting tribe, Fanalis. Her name is based on the slave girl who served Alibaba in "Alibaba and the forty thieves". Morgiana was Jamil’s slave before.
46502: One of the eight generals, he has terrific skills in fencing. He is a poseur. He has a personality to not do anymore work after off-duty. He also goes drinking often. His optimistic personality changes into a violent personality during sword practice.
46819: Kougyoku Ren is the Kou Empire's eighth Princess. Kougyoku is a Dungeon Capturer and owner of the Djinn, Vinea. Kougyoku is a very willful person. She tends to act childish, but she can become serious if the situation calls for it.
46821: Cassim was an old friend and the adoptive brother of Alibaba Saluja. When Cassim was younger, he lived in the slums of Balbadd with his sister and father. One day, his father was beating him and his sister until they were saved by Alibaba Saluja's mother, Anise Saluja.
46823: Hakuei's younger brother, he is currently the fourth prince in the Kou Empire. As he was taught to be able to do everything on his own by his sister, he is good at cooking.
46827: Jamil was the Slave Owner of Morgiana and Goltas. Jamil was the chief of Qishan.
53329: One of the eight generals. He uses the weapon household's vessel "Balalark Kauza." He is also a "Fanalis," like Morgiana. He does not speak a lot usually and is seen as emotionless and unfriendly. However, he is really kindhearted—he just doesn't show it often.
54577: He is the first prince of Kou Empire. He's the General Commander of the Kou Empire's Western Subjugation Army together with his brothers, Koumei Ren and Kouha Ren. Kouen is a Dungeon Capturer, capturing three Dungeons, and one of Judal's King Candidates.
54593: A djinn that resides in Aladdin's flute. He is the keeper of the "Sacred Temple". Although he has a huge body, his head is in a different space. Hence, his head will not come out from the flute.
54595: One of the eight generals. Due to her looks, she has complicated feelings towards sexy girls. Her only female friend is Yamuraiha. Although she is good at pretending to cry, she says it no longer works on Ja'far.
54597: One of the Eight Generals of Sindria, from the Sasan Kingdom. He is the younger brother of Mystras Leoxses, and youngest son of Darius Leoxses.
54601: Hinahoho is one of the eight generals.
54605: Cadre of the 'Fog Troupe'. She uses the magical weapon 'Sword of the Scarlet Delusional Fog'. Although she is going out with Hassan, they often get into fights.
54607: Cadre of the 'Fog Troupe'. He wears a patch over his left eye. He uses the weapon 'Sword of the Yellow Corrosive Fog'. Although he is going out with Zaynab, they often get into fights.
54609: He is a member of the Al Sarmen. He works as Balbadd’s financial advisor, with the name 'Banker'. He was also Jamil's tutor.
54611: A djinn of maniacal love and chaos. With the power to control wind, she is contained within Hakuei's Flabellum.
54613: A djinn of stern and etiquette. In the 7th Dungeon's basement, in a city that spread out there, Aladdin and the others met Amon, a polite yet rigid djinn. He materialized in the form of a muscular, bearded old man with an intimidating air.
54615: Alibaba's mother. He described her as a gentle and cheerful person.
54617: Balbadd's previous king and father of Alibaba, Abhmad and Sabhmad. Also he had close connections with Sinbad as he taught him a lot of things.

54621: Goltas was a slave of Jamil, with Morgiana.
54623: Sahsa and her family caravan helped Aladdin when he was starving. Sahsa's best friend is Leila.
54625: Leila is a merchant and a former thief. Leila's best friend is Sahsa.
54627: Nadja is a girl that almost became a slave of Fatima, until Morgiana saved her.
54629: A slave trader who previously was a slave himself.
54631: Grandaughter of the 155th king of the Kouga clan. She has a little bit of knowledge about the Magi and tells Aladdin about them.
62441: Koumei Ren is the Kou Empire's second Prince. He's a General of the Kou Empire's Western Subjugation Army together with his brothers, Kouen Ren and Kouha Ren. Koumei is a Dungeon Capturer, capturing one Dungeon, and one of Judar's King Candidates.
65107: Yunan is one of the four Magi in the current era. It is revealed that he is the one who raised the first dungeon, Baal, 14 years before the start of the story.
65109: Scheherazade is one of the four Magi in the current era. It is revealed she has lived for over 200 years supporting the Reim Empire as a great priest.

65119: Ithnan is a magician and a member of Al-Thamen.
65121: Barkak is the right general of the Imperial Army of Balbadd. Barkak is the person who taught Alibaba royal swordplay.
65509: Aladdin's roommate at Magnoshutatt Academy. He is from Heliohapt.
65513: Member of a trio of agents sent by Al Thamen to attack Sindria. A short old man in a wheelchair capable of powerful destructive magic powered by his dark metal vessel.
65515: Matal Mogamett is the Magnostadt Academy Chancellor and seems to have a very important role in the politics of his country. Matal is the person who led the rebellion of Magnostadt against the Mustashim Kingdom.
65517: Member of a trio of agents sent by Al Thamen. A tall and thin man using a rapier-like Dark Metal Vessel to create doppelgangers from his shadow, he also proves to be a very capable swordsman being almost at Sharrkan's level.
65519: Member of a trio of agents sent by Al Thamen to attack Sindria. While in the manga they appear in Toran to ambush Aladdin and his friends after they conquer Zagan, in the anime they break into Sindria after Judal destroys the magic barrier protecting it.
65609: is a former Pirate and a prominent member of Umm Madaura's Crew. When the crew was captured, he, along with his companions, were sent to Sindria, where they currently reside.
65611: The leader of a set of Pirates who robbed ships and their valued contents near the Aktia Kingdom's port. The pirates were mostly made up of young children she kidnapped and brainwashed with her Magic Tool, Holy Mother Halo Fan. Aum (أُمْ) means mother in Arabic
67131: Titus appears as a young, short boy in the Magnostadt arc. He has medium long blonde hair with two small, thin braids.
67133: The head of a school for Gladiators
67137: A gladiator at the school where Alibaba goes to train.
75568: is a half-blood Fanalis, and a member of the Reim Empire's Fanalis Corps. Myron is a member of her brother's, Muu Alexius, Household.
81817: Doron is a High Class Magician of Magnostadt and the Magnostadt Academy. He is Meyer's younger brother and defected from Partevia Empire.
81821: Budel is a greedy merchant who places money before life. Budel is a wealthy wine seller. He is a very arrogant and selfish individual. He puts money over everything else, and always tries to please his bosses. He considers poor people and people who are under him trash.
81823: Mina is a little girl that was traveling with her mother, Alibaba, and Budel. She does like to hear stories about Dungeons and the treasures within them. In the manga, Mina and her mother are free citizens, but in the anime, they were slaves.
81825: Mariam was the younger sister of Kassim. Mariam was a kind young girl, she would cry when her father has become violent. After her father disappeared, she and her brother were adopted by Anise. When Anise had died from an illness, she began to work along with Alibaba and Kassim.
120729: A Magician from the Kou Empire that is studying in Magnostadt. She was in the 6th Kodor with Aladdin.
126895: Former first prince of the Kou Empire and Hakuryuu's older brother
127183: Mystras Leoxses is the older son of Darius Leoxses. He is a candidate for the next Knight-King of Sasan.
127239: Solomon was known as "The World Creator." He was leader of the "resistance" before he became the king of Alma Toran.
153466: Wife of Hinahoho and the daughter of the Chief of the Imuchakk Tribe, Rametoto. Among the Imuchakk Tribe girls, she is noted to be the most beautiful.

231814: Esra was the mother of Sinbad and wife of Badr. Esra was a woman of average height with long black hair tied in a braid, light brown eyes and thick eyebrows. She wore normal Parthevian clothes and hoop-shaped earrings.

234879: He, along with Vittel and Ja'far, was a former assassin of Sham Lash.
264258: Pipirika is a member of the Imuchakk Tribe. She is the daughter of one of the Patriarchs and the sister of Hinahoho.

265104: A part of Kouen Ren's Household Members.
